subject: english
question: **Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence**: Why do they always make such a big fuss about trivial matters?

options.text: Why is such a big fuss always made about trivial matters?
Why such a big fuss is always made about trivial matters?
Why was such a big fuss always made about trivial matters?
Why has such a big fuss always been made about trivial matters?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Why is such a big fuss always made about trivial matters? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice: **Why do they always make such a big fuss about trivial matters?**
 
• To transform it into passive voice, the object of the active sentence (**such a big fuss**) becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The passive structure is formed using **is/are + past participle** for a present tense question.

Correct sentence: *Why is such a big fuss always made about trivial matters?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice Rule:** The subject of the active voice becomes the object in passive voice, and the verb is adjusted accordingly.
 
• **For questions:** The auxiliary verb is placed before the subject in the passive structure.
 
• **Example:** Active: Why do they write letters? → Passive: Why are letters written?
